title: Asketmc RPG
description: Hardcore Vanilla Surival RPG no pay-2-win
body:
> **Asketmc (VCraft RPG)** is a hardcore survival-RPG Minecraft server for players who take survival seriously.
>
> Active since 2012, the project is aimed at mature Russian-speaking players from RU/CIS who value personal achievement, long-term fair progression, and meaningful consequences. There is no pay-to-win and no instant teleportation.
> ## World and Lore
>
> The game takes place in **Heimur**, a flat world carried through time on the back of a giant turtle. The current disk, **Eldros**, is a low-fantasy setting with late-medieval technology. Gunpowder and ancient magic were lost in a catastrophe, and survivors rebuild the world piece by piece.
>
> The lore is deep but optional: you can simply survive, or explore the history behind the Four Spirits — Gilford, SeiSin, Tenur, and Asket, the spirit of Life, Death, and Time.
>
> ## Hardcore Survival
>
> Survival is systemic, not artificial.
>
> * **Body temperature:** climate, altitude, season, time of day, rain, wet clothes, fire, and shelter all matter. Overheating and freezing apply penalties.
> * **Four seasons:** each year has spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Crops, wild plants, day length, and temperature change by season and region.
> * **Nutrition:** food variety matters. Repeating the same meals gives diminishing returns, while a balanced diet slowly improves your character.
>
> ## Real Consequences
>
> * **Death matters:** you lose part of your trained skills and drop items. When lives run out, the story continues through an heir who inherits only part of the predecessor’s abilities.
> * **Karma and PvP:** killing peaceful players damages reputation. Bandits can become wanted targets with rewards.
> * **Nemesis system:** enemies adapt to repeated damage types, forcing you to change tactics.
>
> ## Dangerous World
>
> * Server events include heatwaves, cold snaps, fog, spore storms, toxic rain, northern lights, and rare meteor storms.
> * Mining is risky: unsupported stone can collapse, but skilled miners can detect and prevent cave-ins.
> * Anomalies offer choices, clues, and consequences instead of random instant death.
> * Magic leaves traces through **Aetheric Pollution**, which builds up and requires cleansing.
> * Elite monsters and world bosses must be reached on foot.
> * The Nether is a serious challenge: Piglins are hostile, gold only buys time, and every Nether creature is stronger than surface enemies.
>
> ## Fair Progression
>
> * **No teleport commands:** no `/sethome` or instant travel. Navigation relies on a traveler’s journal showing direction and distance.
> * **Deep character systems:** professions, attributes, armor mastery, alchemy with hidden ingredient properties, and character traits define long-term development.
> * **Codex:** an in-game encyclopedia in Russian and English unlocks knowledge as you discover the world.
>
> ## Settlements and Companions
>
> The economy is barter-based, using resources, gemstones, and shared treasuries instead of money. Towns and provinces run on Towny and grow through resource nodes.
>
> Solo players are supported by **Echo**, a spirit companion that warns of danger, and a hireable **base guard** who protects your home while you are away.
>
> ## How to Start
>
> Entry is open: no whitelist and no custom launcher. Registration is handled in-game with `/register` and `/login`. The required resource pack is loaded automatically by the client.
>
> Wipes happen only during major core updates, usually once every 3–5 years, so progress can last for years.
>
> **Asketmc** is slow, demanding, and fair survival for mature players who value preparation, consequences, and a long character story.
>
> Welcome to Eldros.
